subject: CS471
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos covering advanced operating system security topics. The English selections are primarily high-quality, curriculum-aligned content from well-known creators like Professor Messer. The Arabic selections leverage popular regional educators like Mohamed Zohdy for core topics, though coverage for highly specialized areas like hypervisor security was unavailable, and one selection was made using the low-view-count exception due to a lack of high-reach content.

coverage.note: No videos covered both SELinux and AppArmor; selected the best available on SELinux.
